players.product: AI GPU cloud (liquid + air-cooled data centers; 5 GW secured power, target 150k GPUs)

quarterly_data.signal: IREN's July 20, 2026 release states it raised its year-end AI Cloud annualized run-rate revenue (ARR) target from $3.7bn to more than $4bn, of which approximately 85% is now under contract following new multi-year cloud services contracts with leading AI developers representing $2.8bn in total contract value. Recent contracts include customer prepayments of approximately 45% of the associated GPU capital expenditure, and IREN's customer contracts have a weighted average term of approximately 4 years. Per the release's notes, the $4bn+ ARR target reflects 480MW (gross) of AI Cloud capacity planned by year-end 2026; the Co-CEO adds that 1.2GW is targeted for 2027.
